source_authority.incident_summary: Deviation classifier produced UNCLASSIFIED / hex-stable_id / false-positive deviations forcing manual triage every release (A10:F-A10-010 '14 UNCLASSIFIED hex IDs'; A6:F-A6-008 '20 deviations all NO_ACTION via manual triage'). Compounded by the ambiguous_count vs ambiguous_deviations field-name mismatch (A11:F-A11-009, gates.py:18). Post-fix the gate reads the canonical field name from superclaude.contracts.GATE_FIELD_NAMES and is fail-closed.

expected_contract_invariant: MUST FAIL pre-fix (14 UNCLASSIFIED ambiguous deviations forced manual triage, and the gate read the wrong field name ambiguous_count so it could silently miss them), MUST PASS post-fix (_no_ambiguous_deviations reads ambiguous_deviations from the GATE_FIELD_NAMES SoT and returns False for this 14-ambiguous report — failing closed — while a clean ambiguous_deviations:0 report returns True; a stale ambiguous_count-only report also returns False, proving the field-name mismatch is closed).
